name: White
instructions: Complete 5 rounds. Each round: 3 rope climbs (15 ft), 10 toes-to-bars, 21 overhead walking-lunge steps, then a 400 m run.

name: Nutts
honoree: Canadian Armed Forces Lt. Andrew Richard Nuttall
instructions: Complete in order: 10 handstand push-ups; 15 deadlifts; 25 box jumps; 50 pull-ups; 100 wall-ball shots; 200 double-unders; then run 400 m carrying a plate.
rx: Women: deadlift 175 lb, box 24 in, ball 14 lb to 9 ft, plate 25 lb. Men: deadlift 250 lb, box 30 in, ball 20 lb to 10 ft, plate 45 lb.

name: Murph
instructions: Run 1 mile, complete 100 pull-ups, 200 push-ups and 300 air squats, then run another mile.
The middle three movements may be partitioned; the runs bookend the workout.
rx: Weighted vest if available: women 14 lb; men 20 lb.

name: DT
honoree: U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. Timothy P. Davis
instructions: Complete 5 rounds: 12 deadlifts, 9 hang power cleans and 6 push jerks per round.

name: JT
honoree: U.S. Navy Petty Officer 1st Class Jeff Taylor
instructions: Three rounds with 21, then 15, then 9 reps of each: handstand push-ups, ring dips and push-ups.

name: Kalsu
honoree: U.S. Army 1st Lt. James Robert Kalsu
instructions: Accumulate 100 thrusters. At the start of every minute, including the first minute, perform 5 burpees before returning to thrusters.

name: Michael
instructions: Complete 3 rounds: run 800 m, do 50 back extensions, then 50 sit-ups.

name: Nate
instructions: For 20 minutes, repeat: 2 muscle-ups, 4 handstand push-ups and 8 kettlebell swings.

name: Chad 1000X
honoree: U.S. Navy Senior Chief Chad Wilkinson
instructions: Accumulate 1,000 weighted box step-ups using a 20-inch box.

name: Mr. Joshua
honoree: U.S. Navy Petty Officer 1st Class Joshua Thomas Harris
instructions: Complete 5 rounds: run 400 m, do 30 GHD sit-ups and 15 deadlifts.

name: McGhee
honoree: U.S. Army Cpl. Ryan C. McGhee
instructions: For 30 minutes, repeat: 5 deadlifts, 13 push-ups and 9 box jumps.
rx: Women: barbell 185 lb, box 20 in. Men: barbell 275 lb, box 24 in.

name: The Seven
honoree: Seven CIA personnel killed at Khost, Afghanistan, in 2009
instructions: Complete 7 rounds, with 7 reps of each: handstand push-ups, thrusters, knees-to-elbows, deadlifts, burpees, kettlebell swings and pull-ups.
rx: Women: thruster 95 lb, deadlift 165 lb, kettlebell 53 lb. Men: thruster 135 lb, deadlift 245 lb, kettlebell 70 lb.

name: Jason
honoree: U.S. Navy Petty Officer 1st Class Jason Dale Lewis
instructions: Work through these pairs in order: 100 air squats / 5 muscle-ups; 75 air squats / 10 muscle-ups; 50 air squats / 15 muscle-ups; 25 air squats / 20 muscle-ups.

name: Badger
honoree: U.S. Navy Chief Petty Officer Mark Carter
instructions: Complete 3 rounds: 30 squat cleans, 30 pull-ups and an 800 m run.

name: Manion
honoree: U.S. Marine Corps 1st Lt. Travis Manion
instructions: Complete 7 rounds: run 400 m, then do 29 back squats.

name: Donny
honoree: U.S. Army Spc. Donald L. Nichols
instructions: Six rounds: 21, 15, 9, 9, 15 and 21 reps of both deadlifts and burpees.
